item_name: Rothco NASA Infant One Piece Bodysuit
item_short_desc: A NASA flight suit designed to fit your little space explorer!
description: Designed with little space explorers in mind, this NASA onesie features a space shuttle patch on the right sleeve, a US Flag on the left sleeve and the NASA logo on the left chest. Constructed from a soft 100% cotton jersey knit that allows your baby to move with ease. A tagless label adds more comfort to this space-themed infant one-piece, with brass buttons that make it easy to take on and off for changing.
